items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: I remember that first of him. It was a long time, and I can't remember where back then.

ctx.x: I was just getting ready to start making records. And it was called Jelly Roll. He wasn't named Jelly Roll then, but... What is his first name? Fred?
Yeah, now you see, I remember that first of him. It was a long time, and I can't remember where back then. That wasn't his name. So we named him Jelly Roll.
